Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art game UI title sign, isolated PNG with genuine transparent alpha exterior.
Primary request: one wide hand-carved walnut sign for a cozy, detailed late-night workshop RPG. Small aged-brass bee and honeycomb seal at the left, then exceptionally legible engraved lettering reading exactly "THE HIVE". No other words.
Style/medium: exquisite handmade pixel art; crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, restricted warm earthy palette, nuanced hand-placed highlights and shadow clusters. Tactile walnut grain, cream and aged brass letter inlay, gently worn uneven carved bevel, small brass corner fittings. Dark forest-green enamel behind the small brass bee seal if needed. It must look like a lovingly crafted RPG interface object.
Composition/framing: front orthographic, straight-on, a horizontal sign roughly 4.8 times as wide as tall. Sign fills the frame horizontally with a small transparent margin around every outer edge. Lettering takes most of the usable sign face and is immediately readable at a small UI size. No perspective tilt.
Lighting/mood: warm tactile highlights, subtle surface depth built with pixel clusters.
Text (verbatim): "THE HIVE" — T H E, a space, H I V E. Engraved cream/brass uppercase sign lettering.
Constraints: actual transparent background outside the sign, not a checkerboard drawing, no colored backdrop, no surrounding scene or cast shadow outside the silhouette. Deliver one complete sign only.
Avoid: vector style, glossy mobile UI, photorealism, soft painting, gradients, blurry pixels, extra props, additional words, watermarks.
